activity_summary: Mistress Ansell reckoned the ringing as ale and as a charge. Alse asked whether every noise must be put down as a charge, and was told that in this parish it is. At fourteenthly the glass was turned. The Mayor, in the chain, gave the responses as a man reads a bill of lading. Seven weeks of him remain. He did not speak to you.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Heard the charge, the glass, and the seven weeks, and did not speak to the Mayor.

entities.name: Master Josias Thwaite
entities.context: Reached fourteenthly, on length of days.

entities.name: Sir John Spencer
entities.context: Gave the responses from his pew, short and cold, and did not speak to William.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Reckoned the ale, answered Alse, and shifted her feet when the glass turned.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Asked whether every noise is a charge, and named the chain.

facets.activity: Heard the glass turned at fourteenthly

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: Must every noise be put down as a charge?
